subject: COMMUNICATIO
bill.title: Establishes content and data privacy requirements for chatbot providers.

action.description: Reported and Referred to Assembly Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🔒 NJ A5607 — NJ Eyes New Rules for Chatbots: How Your Conversations Could Change

New Jersey is considering rules for chatbot providers, aiming to protect your privacy. This bill sets standards for how chatbots collect and use your data – specifically, it says chatbot providers can't use your chat logs to show you ads or decide what ads to show you. It also demands clear, easy-to-understand consent for collecting your data, and limits what data they can actually gather. ...
